title: Analista de Cobrança e Retenção
description:
Analista de Cobrança e Retenção – DS.Marketing


Como Analista de Cobrança e Retenção, você será responsável por conduzir o relacionamento com clientes em momentos críticos do ciclo, especialmente em situações de inadimplência, desalinhamento de expectativas ou perda momentânea de percepção de valor.


Seu papel é estratégico: garantir que o cliente mantenha clareza sobre seu plano de crescimento, entenda os próximos passos e execute corretamente a jornada para renovar e recomprar com previsibilidade.


Nesta função, você atuará com abordagem consultiva, combinando princípios de Customer Success, operações de cobrança, recuperação de crédito e gestão de objeções, sempre com foco na manutenção da receita e saúde da carteira.


Responsabilidades

  • Conduzir contatos ativos e receptivos com clientes em atraso, risco de churn ou perda de percepção de valor.
  • Identificar a causa raiz da inadimplência (financeira, técnica, operacional ou de expectativa) e propor caminhos realistas de regularização.
  • Resgatar a visão estratégica do cliente, conectando o plano contratado aos resultados esperados.
  • Estruturar negociações e acordos financeiros que permitam continuidade saudável do contrato.
  • Controlar objeções com técnica e empatia, garantindo que o cliente se sinta acompanhado e orientado.
  • Executar rotinas de cobrança consultiva, evitando processos mecânicos e focando no impacto do plano no negócio do cliente.
  • Acompanhar SLAs de contatos, follow-ups, acordos e compromissos assumidos.
  • Mapear riscos de cancelamento e agir preventivamente para evitar churn.
  • Alimentar o CRM com histórico, status, acordos e próximos passos, mantendo previsibilidade e organização.
  • Colaborar com times internos (CS, financeiro, comercial e operações) na construção de rotinas que melhorem retenção e adimplência.
  • Gerar percepções qualitativas sobre comportamento dos clientes, objeções recorrentes e oportunidades de melhoria no produto/atendimento.


Competências desejadas

  • Comunicação clara e empática: saber conduzir conversas difíceis sem perder a conexão.
  • Sem medo do telefone, nosso clientes quer ser ouvido! Comunicação em voz é mais eficiente!
  • Perfil consultivo: entender o contexto e orientar com visão de negócio.
  • Resiliência emocional: lidar bem com cenários críticos, objeções, frustrações e pressão.
  • Negociação e argumentação: construir acordos viáveis e sustentáveis.
  • Organização e precisão: registrar dados e cumprir processos com excelência.
  • Visão sistêmica: enxergar a jornada completa do cliente e o impacto da retenção na empresa.
  • Disciplina e compromisso: acompanhar pendências, prazos e acordos até a resolução.
  • Colaboração: trabalhar próximo a CS, Financeiro e Comercial para garantir resultado coletivo.


Sobre a DS.Marketing

Empresa especialista em impulsionar vendas no varejo por meio de tecnologia, dados e automação. Democratizamos o acesso ao marketing digital para o empreendor do Brasil profundo!


Modalidade de contratação: CLT

Ambiente de crescimento acelerado, com treinamentos e evoluções constantes

- Documentation & Configuration Management · Maintain detailed technical documentation: requirements traceability, design specifications, and release notes. · Use version control and configuration management tools (Git, Jira, etc.) effectively. · Ensure all software artifacts meet traceability, review, and release standards.

title: Financial Planning and Analysis Manager
description:
What's the role?

We’re seeking a bold, strategic finance leader who thrives in complexity and excels at business partnering. In this high-impact role, you’ll serve as a Finance Business Partner to the Market Organization, helping to steer financial levers and performance. We’re looking for passion about the construction industry with the creativity and courage to challenge the status quo and drive innovation from within. You’ll be working closely with senior executives to shape decisions, drive integration, and ensure long-term value creation. If you're looking for a growth platform within Hilti that could catapult you to future leadership roles, this is it. .

What does the role involve?

As a Finance Manager, you will:


  • Partner directly with functional leaders to shape and execute our growth strategy.
  • Lead the financial performance management cycle, including rolling forecasts and financial steering across sales divisions.
  • Analyze and advise on business cases, investments, and commercial strategies-turning data into action.
  • Own and improve the financial planning processes
  • Collaborate with senior stakeholders to identify operational bottlenecks, propose financial guardrails, and recommend course corrections.
  • Contribute to long-term planning initiatives
  • Ensure compliance and risk alignment while embedding agile, future-proof finance systems and structures.
  • Lead with influence-not authority-by asking challenging questions, probing assumptions, and helping senior stakeholders align on impactful choices.
  • Balance your time between strategic conversations and hands-on finance operations. This is not a traditional accounting role-it’s business partnering at its most influential.



What you need is:

  • Completed bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business, or related field (CPA/CMA/CA is a plus). Master’s degree is a plus.
  • 7–10 years’ experience in finance, consulting, or audit-ideally within multinational organizations.
  • Strong strategic acumen with hands-on experience in budgeting, forecasting, and business planning.
  • Proven success in business partnering roles—working alongside execs and cross-functional teams to drive real outcomes.
  • Ability to influence without authority, simplify complex financial topics, and communicate clearly in fluent English.



What you can expect when applying to a Hilti position:

When applying to a position at Hilti, you can expect a people-centric recruitment process where every application is reviewed by a human (automated notifications are triggered by our recruiting team). Personalized feedback isn’t provided for applications that don’t reach hiring manager interview stage, the overall process—including evaluations and interviews—typically takes 3 to 6 weeks, with most applicants hearing back within 2 to 3 weeks. For tips and more information, you’re encouraged to explore Hilti’s career FAQ section.

title: Tecnico de Campo Jr (Triangulo Mineiro)
description:
Company Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. Our critical communications, video security and command center technologies support public safety agencies and enterprises alike, enabling the coordination that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals and safer businesses. Nossa missão é ser a garantia física de que nossos sistemas de comunicação de missão crítica – que apoiam segurança pública, grandes empresas e serviços essenciais – estejam sempre operacionais e com cobertura máxima. Job Description

Buscamos um(a) Técnico(a) de Campo Júnior proativo(a) e dedicado(a) para integrar nossa equipe no Triangulo Mineiro/MG, atuando na instalação, configuração e manutenção de sistemas de comunicação de missão crítica (RF e Rádio Enlace). Este profissional será essencial para garantir a excelência operacional e a satisfação do cliente na região, com alta disponibilidade para viagens a trabalho.


O Técnico de Campo Júnior será responsável por:

  • Instalação e Configuração:

Realizar a instalação e substituição de partes, peças e módulos em equipamentos de telecomunicações.

Configurar e parametrizar rádios móveis e portáteis nos padrões de comunicação da empresa.

Implementar e configurar equipamentos de Rádio Frequência (RF), incluindo sistemas de Rádio Enlace (Transmissão) e infraestrutura associada.


  • Manutenção e Suporte:

Executar rotinas de Manutenção Corretiva e Preventiva em sistemas de comunicação (RF e infraestrutura).

Garantir o suporte técnico de campo de alta qualidade, interagindo diretamente com o cliente e resolvendo falhas.

Conduzir o tratamento de chamados, realizando a interface técnica e o escalonamento necessário junto ao NOC (Network Operations Center).


  • Documentação e Qualidade:

Elaborar relatórios técnicos detalhados e precisos dos atendimentos, manutenções e instalações realizadas (incluindo As-Built).

Seguir rigorosamente as normas e procedimentos de segurança (NR-10 e NR-35) e os padrões de qualidade da Empresa’s


Basic Requirements

Formação e Certificação:

  • Base: Residir em Uberaba/MG ou região
  • Formação Técnica: Eletrotécnica, Eletrônica, Telecomunicações ou Elétrica.
  • Registro Profissional: Situação regular junto ao CFT (Conselho Federal dos Técnicos Industriais).


Experiência Técnica:

  • Experiência prévia em suporte técnico de campo ou implementação de sistemas de Rádio Frequência (RF).
  • Experiência prática na instalação e configuração de rádios de comunicação (fixos, móveis ou portáteis).
  • Conhecimento básico em infraestrutura de Telecomunicações, incluindo sítios (sites) de RF e torres.


Segurança e Mobilidade:

  • Trabalho em Altura: Experiência em serviços que exigem trabalho em altura e Certificação NR-35 válida.
  • Segurança Elétrica: Conhecimento e Certificação NR-10 válida (Segurança em Instalações e Serviços com Eletricidade).
  • Disponibilidade para Viagens (50%): Alta mobilidade para atendimento na região e estado.
  • Habilitação: CNH válida (Categoria B).


Requisitos Desejáveis (Diferenciais)

  • Padrões de Comunicação: Conhecimento e familiaridade com padrões como TETRA, APCO25 e/ou DMR.
  • Rádio Enlace: Conhecimento prático em instalação e configuração de equipamentos de Rádio Enlace (Links de Transmissão).
  • Redes IP: Conhecimentos sólidos em Redes IP (Camada 2/3) e habilidades de troubleshooting (identificação e resolução de problemas de rede).
  • Idiomas: Inglês - Nível básico para leitura de manuais técnicos e comunicação escrita.
  • Ferramentas: Proficiência em Pacote Office (Word, Excel) e Google Tools (Docs, Sheets).


EEO Statement

Motorola Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other legally-protected characteristic.

We are proud of our people-first and community-focused culture, empowering every Motorolan to be their most authentic self and to do their best work to deliver on the promise of a safer world. If you’d like to join our team but feel that you don’t quite meet all of the preferred skills, we’d still love to hear why you think you’d be a great addition to our team.

title: Analista fiscal Jr
description:
Você conhece a Sany do Brasil?


Fundada em 1989 em Changsha, na China, o Grupo Sany dedica-se à produção de máquinas pesadas, tendo como principais produtos as máquinas para construção civil, pavimentação, escavação, reach stacker, guindastes, máquinas portuárias e de mineração. Há 20 anos, o Grupo Sany tem conquistado progresso e sucesso na sua jornada. Possui dez fábricas na China, uma na Índia, uma na Alemanha e uma nos Estados Unidos, além de aplicar políticas agressivas como a de dedicar 5% de seu faturamento anual em pesquisa e desenvolvimento de novas tecnologias.


Como parte da sua estratégia de crescimento, em 2012, a Sany adquiriu a empresa alemã Putzmeister. A união das áreas de negócios da Sany e da Putzmeister formou o maior líder mundial da área de equipamentos para concreto. Atualmente, a Sany emprega cerca de 40 mil colaboradores em mais de 150 países.


No Brasil, a trajetória do Grupo Sany iniciou em 2007, quando atuava como importador de equipamentos. O ano de 2011 marcou a consolidação do Grupo no país, com o anúncio de investimentos da ordem de US$ 200 milhões. Em janeiro do mesmo ano, a Sany inaugurou na cidade de São José dos Campos, interior de São Paulo, sua primeira unidade fabril para montagem de escavadeiras e guindastes sobre caminhão no regime de CKD (Completely Knock-Down), em uma área total de 30 mil m².


Em 2012 a Sany recebeu da Fundação Carlos Alberto Vanzolini a certificação de qualidade ISO 9001:2008, garantindo o rigoroso processo de qualidade e segurança da empresa.

Em 2013, visando uma nova etapa de crescimento, a Sany iniciou a montagem dos guindastes RT (rough terrain) e dos rolos compactadores na sua unidade fabril.


No final de 2017, inauguramos as nossas instalações na cidade de Jacareí/SP.


A Sany possui uma rede de distribuidores e filiais próprias pronta para oferecer seus produtos e excelentes serviços de pós-vendas em todas as regiões do país.


Como nosso Analista Fiscal, você irá:


  • Conhecimento sobre fato gerador de impostos indiretos: ICMS, ICMS-ST, IPI, PIS COFINS;
  • Análise de documentos fiscais: NFe, CTe NFSe;

  • Conhecimento em registro de notas fiscais de entrada;
  • Conhecimento sobre regras de carta de correção;

A Agropalma é uma empresa brasileira reconhecida em todo o mundo como referência na produção sustentável de soluções com óleo de palma. title: Engenheiro DevOps Pleno/Sênior
description:
Vaga: Engenheiro DevOps Sênior (Infraestrutura, Banco de Dados e Escalabilidade)


Localização: Remoto ou Escritório (Novo Hamburgo - RS)


Sobre nós:


A DKW System é uma empresa inovadora no setor de tecnologia de CRM, omni-channel, inteligência artificial e marketing, que trabalha com uma stack moderna e escalável, voltada para ambientes de alta performance e infraestrutura resiliente. Estamos em busca de um Engenheiro DevOps Pleno/Sênior para gerenciar nossa infraestrutura, bancos de dados e processos de escalabilidade, sempre focando na alta disponibilidade, segurança e performance.



O que você vai fazer:


•⁠ ⁠Gerenciar e otimizar a infraestrutura: Administra servidores, incluindo Linux, Node.js, Redis, RabbitMQ, Nginx, e PostgreSQL.

•⁠ ⁠Escalabilidade e alta disponibilidade: Configurar e implementar soluções de escalabilidade (auto-scaling, balanceamento de carga, failover) em ambientes em nuvem.

•⁠ ⁠Banco de Dados: Tunar e otimizar o banco PostgreSQL para garantir performance, integridade e segurança. Gerenciar backups e replicação.

•⁠ ⁠Monitoramento e Observabilidade: Implementar e configurar ferramentas de monitoramento como Zabbix, New Relic, para garantir alta performance e disponibilidade dos serviços.

•⁠ ⁠Automação e Infraestrutura como Código: Automatizar deploys, pipelines e provisionamento de infraestrutura usando ferramentas como Terraform, Ansible, PM2.

•⁠ ⁠Redes e Segurança: Garantir que a rede e a infraestrutura sejam seguras, com conhecimento profundo de redes (TCP/IP, firewalls, VPNs, etc.) e otimização de tráfego.

•⁠ ⁠Suporte e Troubleshooting: Diagnosticar e corrigir problemas de infraestrutura e banco de dados, garantindo que as aplicações estejam sempre disponíveis e escaláveis.


O que esperamos de você:


•⁠ ⁠Experiência sólida em DevOps: 3+ anos de experiência em ambientes de produção com servidores, infraestruturas e soluções em nuvem (AWS, GCP, etc).

•⁠⁠ Domínio em Banco de Dados PostgreSQL: Experiência prática com tuning de performance, backup, replicação e clusters.

•⁠ ⁠Conhecimento em ferramentas de fila de mensagens: Experiência com Redis e RabbitMQ.

•⁠ ⁠Experiência com servidores e redes: Experiência com Nginx, balanceamento de carga, alta disponibilidade, configuração de servidores e conhecimento em redes TCP/IP.

•⁠ Automação e Monitoramento: Experiência com ferramentas como Zabbix, New Relic, PM2, Terraform, e Ansible.

•⁠ ⁠Experiência em Cloud e escalabilidade: Conhecimento em provedores de nuvem, containers, auto-scaling e infraestrutura resiliente.


Diferenciais:


•⁠ ⁠Experiência com Kubernetes e containers.

•⁠ ⁠Certificações em AWS, GCP, Azure ou áreas correlatas.

•⁠ ⁠Experiência com CI/CD e Infraestrutura como código.



Por que trabalhar com a gente?


•⁠ ⁠Ambiente dinâmico e inovador com um time ágil e altamente colaborativo.

•⁠ Crescimento profissional : Ajudamos no desenvolvimento contínuo de suas habilidades e promovemos oportunidades de aprendizado.



Se você é apaixonado por tecnologia, escalabilidade e soluções de alto desempenho, essa vaga é para você!

  • Apoiar na elaboração e implementação da política de saúde e segurança no trabalho, realizando auditorias, avaliações e inspeções em áreas operacionais (agrícola e industrial).

  • Necessário CNH B;
  • Conhecimento em pacote office.


Localidades:

  • Unidade Andrade | Pitangueiras/SP


O que buscamos num profissional?

Neste cenário de crescimento sustentável, buscamos talentos para enfrentar os desafios do setor, que tenham atitude, sejam engajados e saibam estabelecer parcerias na busca pela excelência.

A Tereos acredita que todos os profissionais podem contribuir com o crescimento do grupo. Por isso, pessoas com deficiência são bem-vindas a nossa empresa.


Sobre a Tereos

Com visão de longo prazo no processamento de matérias-primas agrícolas e desenvolvimento de produtos alimentícios de qualidade, a Tereos é uma das líderes nos mercados de açúcar, álcool/etanol e amidos. Os compromissos do Grupo com a sociedade e com o meio ambiente têm contribuído com a performance da companhia no longo prazo, enquanto reforça nossa atuação responsável. O Grupo cooperativo Tereos reúne 12.000 agricultores e possui expertise reconhecida no processamento de beterraba, cana-de-açúcar, cereais e batata. Com operação em 15 países, 43 unidades industriais e o compromisso de 15.800 colaboradores, a Tereos atende seus clientes em seus mercados locais, com uma oferta ampla de produtos. Em 2022/23, o Grupo obteve um faturamento de € 6,6 bilhões.


Tereos no Brasil

A Tereos no Brasil é composta pela Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil, Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil e Tereos Commodities Brasil. No noroeste do Estado de São Paulo, a Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil concentra suas sete unidades de processamento e duas refinarias. A Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil, com operação em Palmital (SP), diversifica o portfólio da Tereos Brasil com a fabricação de produtos derivados de milho. A Tereos Commodities opera como trading e possui escritórios em diversos países.

title: Strategy and Planning Expert
description:
What You'll Do

Position Summary

We are seeking a highly strategic and analytical Strategy & Planning Expert to join our team and lead the business evolution of our Innovation vertical. This role is responsible for designing, implementing, and optimizing the business model, managing the end-to-end P&L, and serving as the Project Management Office (PMO) for key implementation projects. The ideal candidate will have a strong blend of strategic vision, financial acumen, and operational process design skills to drive sustainable growth and profitability.

Key Responsibilities

  • Business Model Evolution : Design and continuously evolve the business model for the Innovation vertical, including market entry strategies, new service offerings, and go-to-market approaches.
  • P&L Management : Own and manage the P&L for the vertical, including financial forecasting, budget planning, and variance analysis. Identify and execute initiatives to improve profitability and top-line growth.
  • Strategic Planning : Develop and lead the strategic planning process for the vertical, identifying market trends, competitive threats, and growth opportunities. Translate strategy into actionable, measurable plans.
  • PMO for Implementation : Serve as the Project Management Office for all strategic initiatives and key implementation projects within the vertical. Define project scope, manage timelines, track progress, and ensure projects are delivered on time and within budget.
  • Process Design & Improvement : Design, map, and implement new business processes to improve operational efficiency, scalability, and performance. Conduct root cause analysis to identify process bottlenecks and drive continuous improvement.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration : Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including Operations, Product, Sales, and Marketing, to ensure alignment on strategy and execution.
  • Stakeholder Management : Communicate project updates, financial performance, and strategic direction to key stakeholders, including senior leadership.
  • Performance Analysis : Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure business model health, project success, and operational effectiveness.


What We Need From You

  • Education : Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Finance, or a related field. An MBA or advanced degree is highly desirable.
  • Experience : Proven experience in a strategy, planning, business development, or management consulting role, with significant experience in P&L management and process design. Experience in the Food Delivery sector is a plus.
  • Strategic Acumen : Strong ability to think strategically, analyze complex business problems, and develop innovative solutions.
  • Analytical Skills : Highly analytical and data-driven, with strong financial modeling and forecasting skills.
  • Project Management : Expertise in project management methodologies and tools, with experience managing complex, cross-functional projects.
  • Process Design : Experience in mapping, designing, and optimizing business processes.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels.
  • Leadership : A self-starter with a strong sense of ownership and the ability to drive change in a fast-paced environment.

title: Domain Architect Networking
description:
Join one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!


Why join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for a Domain Architect Networking , who wants to learn and transform their career, in a CLT contract, hybrid , in the city of São Paulo.


In this role you will:

The Domain Architect – Networking will play an essential role in the design, governance and evolution of the network architectures that support the digital, industrial and corporate operations of Brasil and Canada. He will be responsible for the strategic planning, specification, integration and optimization of corporate communication platforms: SD-WAN, LAN/WAN, OT/IT industrial networks, Wi-Fi, underground networks, data centers, cloud integration, 5G, satellite and edge for mining.

Its mission is to ensure robustness, availability, performance, security, and scalability – enabling automation, digitalization, advanced analytics, industrial IoT, and support for key critical environments. He will work directly with global IT, Operations, Security, and Engineering teams, supporting multicultural and multifunctional environment.


Main Responsibilities

  • Lead the design, documentation and evolution of enterprise, industrial and mission-critical network architectures for global, underground, remote, mobile/IoT and cloud/hybrid operations.
  • Specify patterns, high and low complexity diagrams (logical view, physical, topology, VLAN, routing, SDN), considering redundancy, availability, performance, and resiliency.
  • Evaluate, select and supervise deployment of emerging technologies: SD-WAN, SDN, Zero Trust, private 5G, mesh networks, VPNs, segmentation of OT/IT networks in a mining environment.
  • Define and ensure compliance with global security standards (ISO 27001, NIST, LGPD, PIPEDA), encryption policies, access control, vulnerability mitigation, and incident response.
  • Lead network integration projects between Brazil, Canada, industrial areas/mines, offices, plants and data centers, enabling high connectivity, performance and security.
  • Orchestrate processes of technological update, equipment replacement, configuration automation and network monitoring, including SRE, observability, Service Mesh.
  • Create and maintain detailed documentation: diagrams, flows, contingency plans, playbooks, usage policies, governance, and technical templates.
  • Direct interface with Engineering, Operations, Security, DevOps, Industrial Automation teams, global architecture teams and strategic suppliers.
  • Monitor, optimize and evolve the communication infrastructure, aiming at maximum efficiency, IoT support, industrial analytics, autonomous mine operation and compliance.
  • Support the development of strategic projects (mining 4.0, edge computing, digital twins, cloud/industrial integration, ESG) and train internal teams.


Requirements and Competencies

Essential Requirements (Hard Skills)

  • Bachelor's degree in Network Engineering, Telecommunications, Computer Science or related.
  • Minimum of 8 years of solid experience as a network architect, working in critical industrial, enterprise/global, multinational and mining/resources environments.
  • Mastery of the main protocols, architectures and standards: TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF/EIGRP, IPv6, DNS/DHCP, VLAN/VRF, MPLS, Wi-Fi, SD-WAN, 5G/Edge, SASE, Zero Trust, OT/IT Convergence.
  • Real experience with Cisco (Switching, Routing, SD-WAN, SDA), Juniper, Arista, Palo Alto, Fortinet, Rockwell/Siemens industrial solutions, cloud networking platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP).
  • Practical interface with complex environments: underground/mining, industrial networks, industrial environments 4.0, cloud integration, high availability, disaster recovery.
  • Experience in network automation (Ansible, Terraform, Python, scripts), advanced monitoring (SNMP, NetFlow, SRE Observability).
  • Excellence in documentation, technical design, governance support, multi-platform integration and international performance with remote teams.
  • Fluent English (essential), advanced Portuguese as a differential for Brazil-Canada integration.


Soft Skills

  • Technical leadership, positive influence, consultative action and consensus building between teams and global cultures.
  • Strategic and analytical ability to plan, execute, and evolve complex, highly available architectures.
  • Clear and assertive communication with stakeholders at all levels, internationally distributed teams.
  • Proactivity, resilience, focus on solutions, adaptability and collaborative posture.
  • Absolute focus on results – operational, safety, innovation and support of infrastructure.

Differentials / Nice to Have:

  • Certificações: CCNP/CCIE, AWS/Azure/GCP Advanced Networking, CISSP, VMware NSX, ITIL Expert, TOGAF.
  • Experience in greenfield/brownfield projects, integration of industrial networks/IoT, edge/mesh/satellite, mine digitalization.
  • Experience with underground networks, mining-specific wireless solutions, industrial OT/IT environments, SRE/observability on a global scale.
  • Participation in technical forums, publications, international events, benchmarks, leadership in strategic projects from or large mining companies.
  • Ability to work in different time zones, multi-site environments and multicultural teams.


Expected Skills & Deliverables, Impact:

  • Robust and secure reference architecture for all Brazil and Canada network environments, including integration, automation, performance and high availability.
  • Execution of strategic projects for technological evolution, digitalization, automation, analytics and ESG, supporting business results.
  • Dissemination of best practices, technical painting of the teams involved, development of governance policies and global operation.
  • Active performance in innovation, benchmarking and implementation of new technologies that support the group's digital and operational transformation.
  • Ensuring compliance, operational resilience, risk mitigation and increasing efficiency for operations.


Additional Comments:

This professional will be a protagonist in the transformation and support of corporate, industrial and critical network architecture, enabling the global Brazil-Canada operation and the group's digital/ESG evolution.

title: Operations Manager
description:
As we prepare to launch our licensed operations in Brazil, we’re seeking a strategic yet hands-on Operations Manager to establish and lead all operational functions on the ground in São Paulo.

Leveraging Ant International’s core platforms for payments, compliance, reporting, and risk, your critical role is to operationalize these global capabilities in the Brazilian context: defining local workflows, adapting procedures to meet BACEN expectations across EMI, payments, and lending (SCD), managing internal partners, and ensuring flawless execution from day one.

With a lean local team and key functions still centralized, you’ll wear multiple hats: acting as builder, executor, regulator liaison as needed, and team leader—while contributing directly to how global practices evolve to serve Brazil’s unique market.


Key Responsibilities:


1. Local Operational Design & Regulatory Alignment

  • Lead the design and implementation of Brazil-specific operational frameworks across two license types: Payment Institution (EMI and PISP) and SCD (lending)—ensuring full alignment with current and upcoming BACEN requirements;
  • Translate regulatory expectations into actionable operational controls, feeding insights back to global teams to refine shared standards;
  • Define end-to-end procedures for payment processing (PIX, TED/DOC), loan disbursement (for SCD), reconciliation, and incident management—mapped to Ant’s global infrastructure;
  • Support Compliance and Business teams on operational matters during licensing reviews, audits, and ongoing supervision.


2. Cross-Border Execution & Global Integration

  • Partner closely with Ant International’s headquarters in China, working with product, risk, compliance, and engineering teams to ensure Brazil’s operational needs are reflected in global systems and policies;
  • Validate that data flows, reporting logic, and control mechanisms support accurate, timely submissions to Brazilian authorities (e.g., SISBACEN, periodic EMI/SCD reports, RFB, Sisbajud/CNJ, Simba, STA, local authorities in general, etc.);
  • Identify gaps between global processes and local regulatory or market realities—and drive pragmatic, compliant adaptations without compromising system integrity.


3. Hands-On Operational Leadership

  • In this foundational phase, personally execute critical tasks: validate regulatory reports, investigate transaction failures, reconcile settlement accounts, and test live workflows;
  • Manage relationships with local banks, payment scheme participants (e.g., PIX connectors), credit bureaus, and third-party vendors—ensuring seamless integration with Ant’s ecosystem;
  • Build and mentor the first wave of local operations talent as the team scales, instilling a culture of compliance, precision, and customer trust.


4. Risk, Controls & Scalability

  • Implement robust operational risk frameworks tailored to Brazil’s multi-product environment (payments + lending), leveraging Ant Group’s global standards while addressing local threats;
  • Maintain a dynamic risk register, lead incident reviews, and ensure all operational activities support BACEN’s fit-and-proper, capital adequacy, and consumer protection expectations;
  • Design scalable processes that can grow with volume—by optimizing configurations, automation, and human oversight within the existing global structure.


Who You Are:


Deep Expertise in Brazil’s Regulated Financial Landscape

  • 7+ years in operations, compliance, or risk within Brazilian banking, fintech, or financial services;
  • Essential: Direct experience with BACEN-regulated entities, particularly EMIs, Payment Institutions, or SCDs—including licensing processes, ongoing reporting, AML/KYC, reserve rules, and consumer credit regulations;
  • Basic knowledge of development/programming languages, APIs, and XML files is a plus;
  • Fluency in Portuguese (native or fluent) and English (professional proficiency/advanced). Chinese is a plus, not mandatory. Must be based in São Paulo.


Builder Mindset with Global Awareness

  • Proven ability to launch or scale operations in early-stage, regulated environments—you’ve operated where structure meets scrappiness;
  • Experience collaborating with international or offshore teams; you know how to influence without authority and translate local needs into global action, with a resilient and problem-solving-oriented approach;
  • Understand that excellence lies not in rebuilding systems, but in making world-class infrastructure work and adapt itself flawlessly in Brazil.


Operational Rigor & Accountability

  • Obsessive about accuracy, audit readiness, and regulatory detail—but also pragmatic and solution-oriented;
  • Equally comfortable presenting to regulators and debugging a reconciliation file at midnight;
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Law, Economics, or related field. Advanced degrees or certifications (e.g., CRC, CEA) are valued but not required.

title: Enterprise Architect
description:
Join one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!


Why join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for a Enterprise Architect , who wants to learn and transform their career, in a CLT contract, hybrid , in the city of São Paulo .


In this role you will:

The Enterprise Architect will be centrally responsible for the strategic definition and implementation of Canada's enterprise architecture, working from the design and governance of systems to the integration of technological platforms and operational mining processes. Its mission is to translate business objectives into modern, secure and scalable architectures, aligned with international standards and the automation, sustainability and innovation goals of the group.

This professional will work in partnership with the global Enterprise Architect and cross-functional areas (IT, Operations, Engineering, ESG), ensuring that each solution offers efficient integration between on-premises, cloud, and industrial automation environments. He will have a profound influence on technology decisions, playing an advisory role with Canadian and Brazilian leadership, promoting a collaborative, innovative and results-oriented environment.

To succeed, you must demonstrate strategic vision, technical leadership, exceptional intercultural communication skills, and mastery of regulatory requirements in both Canada and Brazil.


Main Responsibilities

  • Define, document and evolve integrated Enterprise Architecture models (business, applications, data, technology), using frameworks such as TOGAF/ArchiMate and aligning with the strategic demands of mining, sustainability and digital transformation.
  • Act as a technical reference, leading cross-functional teams, promoting the consolidation of solutions between IT, OT and industrial automation, ensuring adherence to global corporate standards.
  • Evaluate and validate new technologies, platforms, services and methods (Cloud, Edge Computing, Digital Twins, IoT, Analytics, Cybersecurity), always considering the best practices in the mineral and natural resources sector.
  • Develop and maintain architectural criteria that prioritize security, regulatory compliance (LGPD, PIPEDA, GDPR), performance, sustainability and operational integration between Canada and Brazil.
  • Prepare detailed documentation (LLD/HLD, reference architectures, guidelines), transferring knowledge and mentoring technical and business teams both locally and internationally.
  • Lead communication between technical, operations, engineering, and global leaders, promoting efficient collaboration and respecting cultural differences.
  • Continuously analyze technological, regulatory and business trends, proposing standards and improvements that position as an international reference in sustainable and digital mining.
  • Participate directly in the supplier selection/merger processes, prioritizing interoperability, innovation and return on investment in critical projects.


Requirements and Competencies

Essential Requirements (Hard Skills)

  • Proven experience (minimum of 8 years in IT, with at least 5 as an enterprise architect or similar strategic role in Large Enterprise or mining/resources).
  • Deep knowledge of the mineral, energy or industrial sector, preferably previous experience in large global operations (e.g., Petrobras, Rio Tinto, Barrick Gold, Anglo American).
  • Mastery of the main enterprise architecture frameworks (TOGAF: Practitioner, ArchiMate, Zachman, DAMA-DMBOK).
  • Excellence in the use of cloud technologies (Azure, AWS, GCP) and data platforms, cross-system integration (ERP SAP/Oracle, SCADA, IIoT, Data Lake, Data Warehouse, Lakehouse).
  • Ability to design hybrid architectures (on-premises, cloud, edge), industrial data integration (sensing, automation, dashboards, analytics).
  • Strong performance in compliance, industrial cybersecurity (OT/IT Convergence), data protection, disaster recovery and business continuity.
  • Experience in multinational/cross-border projects, especially Brazil-Canada.
  • Fluent English (technical communication, executive meetings, documentation), advanced Portuguese is a strategic differential for integration between teams.


Soft Skills

  • Advanced communication skills, capable of transmitting complex technical concepts to different audiences (executives, engineers, IT, business).
  • Global strategic vision, aligning local and global initiatives with corporate objectives in sustainable mining, innovation and automation.
  • Analytical and solution-oriented thinking, with high ability to navigate complex, multifunctional and multicultural environments.
  • Collaborative leadership – mentoring, consensus building, influence without direct authority, and excellent internal/external networking skills.
  • Management of priorities, organization and resilience in the face of multiple parallel projects and ad-hoc demands.
  • Absolute focus on results, delivering tangible value for operation, innovation and sustainability.


Differentials / Nice to Have:

  • TOGAF (Expert) certification, AWS/Azure/GCP Solution Architect, CISA, PMP/Agile, specializations in ESG, digital mining, cyber OT/IT.
  • Hands-on experience with emerging platforms: Digital Twins, AI/ML/Ops, real-time streaming (Kafka, Spark Streaming, Flink), infrastructures as code (Terraform, CloudFormation).
  • Experience in due diligence processes, merger & acquisition, integration of multi-company systems.
  • Active participation in architecture forums, mining, global events, technical publications or international presentations.
  • Background with SAP, Oracle, SIEMENS, Rockwell, GE Predix, Azure IoT/Edge/Analytics solutions, sustainability frameworks and ESG reporting.


Expected Skills & Deliverables, Impact:

  • Align the needs of global business, Canada and Brazil with the vision of enterprise architecture and technological roadmap.
  • Ensure that all solutions meet requirements for scalability, security, performance, regulatory compliance and operational excellence.
  • To be an agent of transformation and innovation, proposing disruptive solutions to digital and operational challenges in the mining sector.
  • Mentor and develop technical capacity of the teams, promoting architecture culture, documentation and standardization.
  • Lead the preparation and presentation of business cases, technical justifications and architectural alternatives to senior executives and regional and global boards.
  • Organize, sustain and evolve architecture governance, support strategic decisions and ensure the permanent alignment of solutions with business objectives and international compliance.


Additional Comments:

This is a key role in Canada's technological and cultural transformation, requiring active action in multicultural environments, with flexibility for travel, meetings in different time zones and continuous adaptation to trends in the mining sector and global architecture. The presence of fluent English is mandatory, while mastery of Portuguese enhances Brazil-Canada integration, directly impacting the success of the project. Technical certifications, previous experience in operations, participation in modernization/digitalization initiatives and innovative mindset will be major differentials in the selection process.

title: Head of Charging
description:
About Vammo


Vammo is building an accessible, resilient, and scalable clean energy network for emerging megacities, starting in Latin America. By combining electric motorcycle subscriptions with a rapidly expanding battery swap infrastructure, we make clean transportation affordable and reliable for the millions who keep cities moving.


Founded in 2022 and headquartered in São Paulo, Vammo has raised $100M from top-tier investors across the globe. Our founders and team represent an incredibly diverse and international group that is built of former executives coming from Tesla, Uber, Rappi, iFood, Loggi, Niu, Jump and others. We are all deeply motivated by the mission to decarbonize Latin America while simultaneously reducing costs for one of the region’s most vulnerable populations.


The next wave of mobility innovation will come not from San Francisco, but from São Paulo. Our operations will soon expand from Sao Paulo to cities across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia, proving that real climate impact and transformative business models can be built first where the need is greatest.


About the role


As the Head of Charging Operations, you will be the executive leader responsible for defining and executing the strategy for the reliability, efficiency, and scalability of Vammo's battery-swapping network which is the heart of our customer experience.


Reporting directly to the Founders, you will build and lead the organization that ensures not only the expansion of our charging network, but also its 24/7 operation. You will be the ultimate owner of this network efficiency and quality, managing the LiveOps, Field Operations, and Commercial Charging Teams, being responsible for preparing the area for 10x growth. This is a mission-critical leadership role that demands strategic vision, the ability to build high-performance teams, and a deep sense of ownership.


What You'll Do

  • Define the end-to-end Charging Ops strategy, including the detailed strategic plan and OKRs. Own the design of processes, systems, and team architecture required to scale the operation by 10x, improve efficiency, and increase customer satisfaction.
  • Own the area's full budget and P&L, managing and optimizing costs to meet company goals.
  • Define and monitor the area's core OKRs and KPIs.
  • Recruit, develop, and lead high-performing teams across LiveOps, Field Operations, and Infrastructure. Define the area's vision and culture, focusing on urgency, accountability, and data-driven problem-solving.
  • Serve as the ultimate owner of network uptime, reliability, and incident response, ensuring riders always have batteries available.
  • Own the end-to-end energy strategy to reduce cost per kWh, including managing procurement, exploring free market (Mercado Livre) opportunities, and implementing efficiency initiatives.
  • Lead the commercial and expansion strategy for the network, defining site selection criteria to secure prime locations and network balance, negotiating strategic partnerships, and overseeing installation/launch playbooks.
  • Build proactive Customer Experience (CX) processes to communicate downtime and protect our NPS.
  • Serve as the strategic voice of operations for the Product and Engineering teams, providing real-world feedback and guiding the hardware/software roadmap to improve operability.
  • Act as the final escalation point for critical incidents, conduct post-mortems, and implement structural changes to prevent recurrence.


What We're Looking For

  • 8-12 years professional experience
  • Excellent knowledge of Brazil and Latin American business practices
  • Track record of scoping, building, training and leading large multidisciplinary teams
  • Proven expertise in process design, optimization, and creating Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for large-scale operation
  • An analytical and strategic mindset, with strong data-driven decision-making skills and experience defining OKRs
  • Executive communication and influencing skills, capable of aligning tech, executive, and field teams.
  • Excels in planning and executing initiatives of varying durations and scales while effectively managing stakeholders.
  • Fosters collaborative and respectful work environments
  • Technical Curiosity, a drive to understand how systems, hardware, and data truly work and how to optimize them.
  • Experience in high-growth (hyper-growth) startups
  • Experience managing 24/7 systems.
  • Experience setting and leading priorities, objectives and strategic direction for entire orgs
  • Experience in mobility, energy, logistics, IoT, or telecommunications is a plus.
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese.
  • Strong alignment with the company’s values


Benefits

  • A leadership role at fast-growing startup changing the face of mobility in Latin America, backed by some of the best venture capitalists in the world
  • Working at a mission driven company - we are reducing carbon emissions across the world and putting more money into the pocket of disenfranchised populations
  • Being surrounded by a talented and ambitious team that wants to build something big 
  • Freedom to take on as much responsibility as you dare, allowing you to develop quickly
  • Competitive salary package
  • Opportunity to own a piece of the company - equity package
  • Health Insurance

title: Domain Architect Host and Cloud
description:
Join one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!


Why join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for a Domain Architect Host and Cloud, who wants to learn and transform their career, in a CLT contract, hybrid , in the city of São Paulo .


In this role you will:

The Domain Architect – Host and Cloud is responsible for structuring, governing, and accelerating the integration of on-premises infrastructures, data centers, and cloud environments of Brasil and Canada's operations. Its role is to ensure robustness, resilience, security, and scalability in sustaining the main systems, supporting digitalization, automation, energy optimization, ESG, and industrial innovation projects.

He will work directly on critical migration, modernization and platform integration projects, leading best practices in cloud computing, edge/fog, hybrid architecture, infrastructure automation, regulatory compliance and performance. This professional will have a strategic role with the global IT, technical operations, security, and business teams, sustaining and transforming multi-site and multicultural technological environment.

Main Responsibilities

  • Define, document and evolve host (mainframe, midrange, industrial servers) and cloud (Azure, AWS, GCP, Oracle Cloud) infrastructure architecture standards, aligned with global demands and multi-cloud/hybrid strategies.
  • Lead digital transformation projects, including migration of on-premises loads to the cloud, integration of critical infrastructures, automation, containerization, DevOps and continuous improvement of environments.
  • Orchestrate the implementation of solutions oriented to resilience, cybersecurity, scalability, disaster recovery, advanced backup and cost optimization.
  • Ensure adherence to international security standards (ISO 27001, NIST, LGPD, GDPR, PIPEDA) and best practices in data governance and operations.
  • Support the design and implementation of robust network, storage, virtualization, automation, edge/fog topologies in complex and distributed environments.
  • Develop and maintain advanced technical documentation: diagrams, manuals, processes, automation templates, observability policies, and operational standards.
  • Follow trends and innovation in cloud, edge, intelligent infrastructure, green IT and automation, evaluating adoption opportunities in operations.
  • Direct interface with Operations, Engineering, DevOps, Security, Business and global architecture teams.
  • Produce complete documentation, guides, contingency plans, training, and best practices for support and operation teams.
  • Participate in forums, workshops, and innovation projects to keep the technological environment in line with global trends.

Requirements and Competencies

Essential Requirements (Hard Skills)

  • Higher education in Engineering, Computer Science, Systems or related areas.
  • Minimum experience of 8 years in technological infrastructure architecture, with relevant performance in complex multi-cloud environments, critical data centers and automation.
  • Mastery of architecture, automation and management of hybrid environments (on-prem, cloud, colocation, edge/fog) at corporate scale, with hands-on experience in Azure, AWS, GCP.
  • Solid track record in network governance, storage, virtualization, backup, industrial topologies, data protection and technological integration of critical environments (OT/IT).
  • Real experience in projects to migrate systems, workloads or data centers to the cloud, with planning, execution and monitoring of results.
  • Excellence in infrastructure automation (Terraform, Ansible, ARM, CloudFormation), observability, cycled and advanced monitoring.
  • Practice with compliance and security: zero-trust, IAM, encryption, vulnerability management, disaster recovery.
  • Fluent English (essential), advanced Portuguese/Spanish desirable for Brazil-Canada integration.


Soft Skills

  • Technical leadership, positive influence and ability to build consensus across areas, countries and cultures.
  • Strategic and analytical capacity to design efficient, secure and business-aligned solutions.
  • Clear and efficient communication with stakeholders, from technical leadership to global executive levels.
  • Proactivity, autonomy and adaptability for dynamic and multicultural environments.
  • Focus on value delivery, continuous improvement and innovation.

Differentials / Nice to Have:

  • Certification: Azure/AWS/GCP Architect, VMware, Cisco, LPIC, TOGAF, ITIL Expert.
  • Experience with OT/IT integration (industrial environments, mining, remote automation), edge/fog.
  • Experience with architectures for sustainability: Green IT, energy saving, resource optimization.
  • Previous experience in mainframe/midrange modernization projects, containerization, SRE/metrics.
  • Participation in global forums, technical communities, presentations, publications.


Expected Skills & Deliverables, Impact:

  • Detailed reference architecture for host and cloud environments, including integration, automation, observability, and resiliency solutions.
  • Execution of strategic migration and modernization projects with a focus on performance, innovation, compliance and operational excellence.
  • Support for the adoption of global standards of governance, security and cost/efficiency optimization in the Brazil and Canada environments.
  • Dissemination of good practices, technical mentoring for internal teams and continuous training.
  • Acting as an innovation agent, aligning technological evolution with sustainability, security, scalability and business results.



Additional Comments:

This role is central to the digital transformation, sustainability, automation and integration of critical environments between Brazil and Canada. It requires strategic, technical and multicultural action, with protagonism in complex environments, willingness to innovate and a strong sense of global partnership.

Maior atacadista brasileiro em número de lojas, o Atacadão está presente em mais de 190 cidades espalhadas por todos os estados do Brasil. Com uma história de 60 anos e mais de 60 mil colaboradores, a empresa tem mais de 280 unidades de autosserviço e 33 atacados de entrega, que garantem o abastecimento de comerciantes, transformadores e consumidores finais. Também atua no e-commerce, integrando o canal de vendas online do próprio Atacadão com uma robusta operação de marketplace, com mais de 300 sellers parceiros de atacado. Em 2021, pela sexta vez, o Atacadão foi eleito pelo "Prêmio Época Reclame Aqui" como a empresa que melhor atendeu seus clientes dentre todos os supermercados e atacados do Brasil. A rede também lidera o Ranking ABAAS, a Associação Brasileira dos Atacadistas de Autosserviço que elenca as redes que mais faturaram em 2021.


GRUPO CARREFOUR BRASIL


Somos hoje o maior empregador privado do País com 150 mil colaboradores e colaboradoras unidos no propósito de contribuir para uma alimentação mais acessível e de qualidade aos brasileiros e brasileiras, colaborando assim com a saúde e o bem-estar de todos e todas.

Com a aquisição do grupo BIG, em junho de 2022, demos início a mais uma etapa da nossa jornada que já dura 47 anos no Brasil. Unimos o melhor dos dois grupos e somos agora uma empresa mais diversa, com maior capacidade de inovar e causar impacto positivo na sociedade. Além de gerar mais de R$ 100 Bilhões em receitas e liderança no setor de 23% de Market Share.

Estamos investindo fortemente na simplificação e na aceleração digital, pois acreditamos que esse é o caminho para nos transformar e sermos protagonistas da mudança que queremos ver no país.

Trabalhar no Grupo Carrefour Brasil é participar diariamente de tudo isso, em um ambiente que respeita e acolhe as diferenças com muito espaço para crescer e aprender. Somos muitos e queremos ser ainda mais.

E você também pode fazer parte dessa grande jornada. Com você, seremos ainda maiores.


Sobre a área: Responsável pela consultoria tributária, analisando legislação e comunicando-se com clientes para fornecer análises e solicitar informações

Localização: Próximo a ponte do Tatuapé


Desafios dessa posição:

● Analisar documentos fiscais e tributários, garantindo conformidade com a legislação vigente;

● Elaborar relatórios fiscais e gerenciais para suporte à tomada de decisão;

● Acompanhar o cumprimento das obrigações legais e tributárias;

● Levantar e organizar informações para estudos e análises tributárias;

● Realizar a conferência e validação de lançamentos fiscais;

● Pesquisar e acompanhar atualizações na legislação tributária aplicável.


Você precisa ter:

● Disponibilidade para trabalhar no modelo presencial

● Ensino superior completo ou cursando em administração, ciências contábeis e direito ou áreas afins;

● Conhecimento intermediário em Excel (Procv, soma C);

● Experiência com fiscal/tributário;

● Conhecimento básico com ICMS e PIS/COFINS.




VOCÊ MERECE O MELHOR

● Vale transporte ou estacionamento no Local

● Restaurante no Local;



No Grupo Carrefour a valorização da diversidade e a promoção de uma cultura inclusiva é um compromisso. Aqui queremos que todas as pessoas se sintam incluídas!

title: Analista de Informações Gerenciais PIeno

Acreditamos que a cooperação nos conecta para crescermos juntos.

Pelo 7º ano consecutivo, a Seguros Unimed integra o ranking dos Lugares Mais Incríveis para Trabalhar 2025, da FIA e do Estadão. E este ano, alcançamos o patamar MÁXIMO: somos O MAIS INCRÍVEL!

Siga nossa página aqui no LinkedIn e fique por dentro de nossas oportunidades de carreira.

Venha fazer parte da Seguros Unimed e ter uma Jornada Incrível conosco!


O que oferecemos nessa Jornada:

Além disso, você encontra por aqui:

  • Ambiente de Trabalho Inovador;
  • Oportunidades de Crescimento na Organização;
  • Diversas parcerias e descontos pela região.



No seu dia-a-dia:

  • Realizar processos de geração de informações gerenciais, emitindo relatórios mensais de controle (Cotações, orçamento, produtividade, custos)
  • Elaborar, desenvolver e analisar indicadores operacionais e estratégicos, identificando e explicando suas variações.

Esperamos de você:

  • Formação Superior em Administração de Empresas, Ciências Contábeis, Economia ou áreas afins.
  • Experiência em atividades correlatas.
  • Vivência na criação, análise e manutenção de indicadores e relatórios gerenciais.
  • Habilidade em modelagem e construção de sistemas de informações.
  • Conhecimento em gestão e acompanhamento de orçamento, com análise de custos e desvios.
  • Domínio de Power B.I, Excel (tabela dinâmica, fórmulas) e PowerPoint para elaboração de relatórios e apresentações.
  • Capacidade analítica para validação de dados e investigação de desvios (ex: Seguro Saúde).


Informações adicionais:

  • Vaga extensiva a Pessoas com Deficiência - PCD;
  • Tipo de contrato: CLT;
  • Local de trabalho: São Paulo - SP
  • Todos os nossos processos seletivos são totalmente on-line nas etapas iniciais.


A Seguros Unimed respeita a pluralidade de identidades e trabalha para promover uma cultura inclusiva. Não fazemos distinção de raça, cor, religião, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade em nenhuma etapa do processo seletivo, reforçando nosso compromisso de uma empresa focada em cooperar e no seu cliente interno e externo.

title: Senior/Team Lead Finance Manager / Brazil / VBET
description:
About the Company

VBET is an award-winning sports betting and gaming operator with 20 years of experience in the industry powered in-house by BetConstruct. We have shifted from a start-up to an extensive international company holding over 10 licenses and operating in over 120 countries. VBET’s mission is to give our customers the best betting and gaming experience in a safe and secure environment.


About the Role

We are seeking an experienced, high-impact Financial Manager to be the definitive financial authority for our Brazilian entity. This is a crucial, high-visibility, hands-on role that requires a sharp blend of technical accounting expertise and strategic commercial insight.


Location: São Paulo, Brazil

Type: Full-time (on-site)

Reports to: Group CFO, local CEO


Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary financial authority for the entity, ensuring overall financial health and robust practice commitment
  • Guarantee full compliance by overseeing regulatory obligations and managing the administration of required IP and Acquiring Licenses
  • Maintain high-level regulatory communication with key external stakeholders
  • Provide hands-on accounting expertise; manage record accuracy and collaborate with external outsourcing partners for daily transactional support
  • Drive process optimization by working with the colleagues to analyze, document, and streamline internal workflows
  • Ensure data integrity and financial analysis capabilities, leveraging Excel, Google Sheets, and SQL
  • Own the Financial Planning & Forecasting function (Budget, Cash Flow, and Financial Integrity)
  • Develop cross-border financial structures to optimize operations and compliance for international merchants
  • Spearhead payment innovation to reduce costs and implement new, efficient payment solutions


✅ Ideal Candidate Profile

  • Proven, hands-on experience (5+ years) in accounting and finance, with a strong background in preparing and overseeing financial statements
  • Mandatory experience in the iGaming sectors
  • High proficiency in Excel, Google Sheets, and a strong command of SQL for data analysis
  • Strong data analysis and financial modeling skills
  • Fluent English and Portuguese languages

title: Product Owner | Recebíveis e Garantias
description:
Descrição da vaga

Orgulhosamente, somos um dos principais bancos do Brasil. Aqui, não nos contentamos com o status quo. Estamos sempre em busca de melhorias, aprendizado contínuo e inovação. Procuramos pessoas que sejam apaixonadas por mudanças, que tenham vontade de aprender e queiram crescer no mercado financeiro. Se você se identifica, venha fazer parte do nosso time!


Estamos em busca de um(a) Product Owner para liderar uma squad estratégica focada em recebíveis e garantias , com impacto direto na evolução das soluções de crédito PJ da companhia. Essa posição será responsável pela estruturação do tema Duplicata Escritural no banco e exige uma combinação de visão estratégica, capacidade analítica e forte atuação junto a times técnicos e stakeholders de negócio.


Quais serão as atividades do dia a dia?


  • Liderar o ciclo completo de desenvolvimento de produtos relacionados a recebíveis como garantia, com foco em duplicata escritural, recebíveis de cartão e outras garantias operadas pelo banco.
  • Atuar como ponte entre áreas técnicas e executivas, garantindo alinhamento entre a execução operacional e os objetivos estratégicos da empresa.
  • Conduzir discovery com clientes internos e externos para identificar oportunidades de melhoria e inovação.
  • Definir e priorizar o backlog da squad, com base em dados, viabilidade técnica e impacto no negócio.
  • Monitorar indicadores de performance dos produtos e propor ações de melhoria contínua.
  • Trabalhar em parceria com áreas como Crédito, Comercial, Jurídico, Riscos, Tecnologia e Compliance.

Requisitos imprescindíveis:

  • Experiência comprovada como Product Manager em produtos financeiros, preferencialmente com foco em crédito PJ ou banking.
  • Capacidade de transitar entre o nível operacional (com squads técnicas) e o estratégico (com diretoria e alta liderança).
  • Habilidade em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) e ferramentas de gestão de produto (Jira, Confluence, etc.).
  • Perfil analítico, com boa comunicação e foco em resultados.


Alguns diferenciais interessantes para a vaga:


  • Conhecimento sólido em duplicata escritural, recebíveis de cartão e estruturas de garantias.
  • Conhecimento em regulamentações do BACEN relacionadas a recebíveis e garantias.
  • Experiência com integração de sistemas de registro (CIP/Núclea, CERC, etc.).

  • Seguro Saúde;
  • Plano Odontológico;
